content_sections.heading: EFLU Tutor in Foreign Languages Overview

rows.details: English and Foreign Languages University (EFLU), Hyderabad
Department of Germanic Studies, Department of Asian Languages
Tutor in German, Tutor in Japanese
Rs. 30,000 – Rs. 50,000/- per month (decided based on performance)

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The English and Foreign Languages University offers a total of 14 temporary tutor positions under the Centre for Consultancy and Language Training (CCLT) for teaching skill-based courses for medical professionals.

rows.qualification: MA (German) OR BA (Hons. / Hons. With Research) 4-year degree in German with 75% marks OR a BA (Hons.) (3 years) in German with 75% marks or a higher degree in German from a recognized University.
rows.experience: Desirable: Teaching experience in German or/and B2 or higher certificate from Goethe Institute / TELC, Experience of teaching German to medical professionals or/and.

rows.qualification: A Bachelor's (three/four year) degree and above with minimum of 75% aggregate marks in any discipline (desirable Japanese) from a recognized university AND a valid Japanese-Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) certificate at N3 level or above.
rows.experience: Desirable: Adequate Japanese language proficiency to teach or facilitate caregiving-related vocabulary, occupational expressions, professional communication and relevant instructional materials. Relevant knowledge, training or demonstrable competence in caregiving, healthcare communication or related occupational contexts. Sufficient English-language proficiency. Ability to explain Japanese language expressions and terminology. Relevant teaching professional training or subject-specific competence.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The remuneration for the Tutors in Foreign Languages is fixed between Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 50,000 per month, with the exact salary decided based on the performance of the candidate. The appointment is made on a temporary basis for a duration of two years, spanning from October 2026 to September 2028.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EFLU Tutor in Foreign Languages
content_sections.text: Prepare your curriculum vitae (CV) clearly mentioning a valid email ID and mobile number. Send the application via email to the official address at [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent on or before 19 October 2026 . Mention the correct subject line in the email reading "Application for the Tutor - [Language]" (e.g., "Application for the Tutor-Japanese").

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae (CV) with valid email ID and mobile number

faq.question: Q1. Is the Tutor position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The Tutor positions are offered on a temporary basis for a duration of two years, running from October 2026 to September 2028.

faq.question: Q2. What is the subject line required for the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must write "Application for the Tutor - [Language]" in the subject line of the email (for example, "Application for the Tutor-Japanese").

faq.question: Q3. What are the desirable qualifications for the Tutor in Japanese post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include adequate Japanese language proficiency for caregiving-related vocabulary and occupational expressions, relevant knowledge or training in healthcare communication, sufficient English proficiency, and teaching experience or training in Japanese language instruction for caregiving, healthcare, or vocational education fields.

faq.question: Q4. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies, consisting of 7 tutors in German and 7 tutors in Japanese.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the curriculum vitae by email is 19 October 2026.
